v2.c.intro: I'm Paulo, a Senior Mobile Engineer with 7 years of experience in Flutter. I build scalable and reliable mobile applications, combining engineering best practices, solid architecture, and a strong focus on business needs. From the first line of code to app store release, I turn ideas into mobile products.
v2.about.1: I've been developing mobile applications with Flutter since 2019, gaining 7 years of experience across industries such as fintech, payments, retail, toll systems, fleet management, mobility, and food delivery. Throughout my career, I've worked on both large-scale applications with extensive user bases and products built from the ground up, contributing to the entire development lifecycle, including App Store and Google Play releases.
v2.about.2: My work goes beyond feature implementation. I've been involved in architectural decisions, offline-first solutions, technical estimations, and code reviews, always striving to balance engineering quality with business needs.
v2.about.3: I enjoy sharing knowledge, collaborating with fellow developers, and exploring new challenges. I'm currently expanding my expertise into backend development with Node.js, aiming to broaden my ability to build end-to-end solutions.

v3.lux: A two-sided card game where wizards summon combos into a shared circle. Designed for phone, tablet and web, in English, Portuguese and Spanish, built with Flutter.
pj.clima.p: A minimalist weather app built natively with Swift and UIKit. It finds you with CoreLocation, searches any city and shows live conditions from the OpenWeatherMap API, structured with MVC and the delegate pattern.
pj.cep.p: A Flutter app that looks up Brazilian postal codes (CEPs) with the ViaCEP API and saves addresses for later. Built with BLoC and Equatable, HTTP for network requests and SharedPreferences for local storage.
pj.bin.p: A Flutter web app that adds, subtracts, multiplies and divides binary numbers from 0 to 255 and finds the remainder, showing every result in binary and decimal.
pj.cof.p: A coffee ordering app built to practise UI design and a clean Cubit architecture. Browse by category, customise size, flavour and topping, then review the cart and check out. Each feature's state lives in its own Cubit from flutter_bloc, covered by bloc and widget tests.
